newsitem.title: USA: First Australia Fund sets semi-annual div.
newsitem.headline: First Australia Fund sets semi-annual div.

text.p: First Australia Fund Inc said on Wednesday it set a semi-annual distribution of $0.265 per share.

The distribution consists of $0.119 per share of net investment income and realized currency gains payable in cash. The remaining $0.146 per share -- payable in stock unless shareholders elect to receive cash -- is composed of $0.035 in short-term capital gains and $0.111 in long-term capital gains.

The $0.119 per share cash distribution is payable on January 17, 1997 to shareholders of record on December 31, 1996. The $0.146 per share stock distribution will be payable on January 31 1997 to shareholders of record on December 31.
The fund's previous distribution, paid in July, was $0.15 per share, making total distributions declared for the year $0.415 per share.
First Australia Fund Inc is a closed-end equity fund.
